question: By whom and in what attire is the visualized form surrounded?
premises: The world-guardians beginning with Indra surround the form.
Those surrounding figures wear copper-colored garments.
The visualized form is encompassed by them.
inference: The contemplated form is surrounded by the world-guardians beginning with Indra, who wear copper-colored garments.
plain_english: He is surrounded by the world-guardians beginning with Indra, who are clothed in copper-colored garments.
